source: Real (after-inflation) annual return percentiles for a diversified stock-heavy portfolio over a decade, in the region of the long-run US record: about 2% at the 25th percentile of ten-year outcomes, 5% at the median, 8% at the 75th.
confidenceNote: Planning bands, not a distribution fitted to data. Chosen to bracket the household's own expectedReturnRate assumption (7% nominal ≈ 5% real) so the default column matches the rest of the app and the other two say how wide 'about' is.
note: Percentiles of annual real return, used by engines/events.js as a flat rate over the horizon. D-086.
